about: Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited provides a range of banking and financial services to corporate and individual customers in India. It operates through Corporate/Wholesale Banking; Retail Banking; Treasury, BMU and Corporate Centre; Vehicle Financing; Other Lending Activities; Broking; Advisory and Transactional Services; Asset Management; and Insurance segments.
